about: Built from en.uesp.net via its MediaWiki API (action=parse wikitext) on 2026-10-27, by an agent that saw only the names in batch0-3; nothing from memory. Bujold the Intrepid redirects to the page Skyrim:Bujold the Unworthy.

people.name: Edda
people.byDay: Near the market stalls, asking for septims
people.byNight: Sleeps in Beggar's Row between midnight and 7am
people.role: Imperial beggar
people.sells: doesn't sell (UESP shows no merchant role)
people.quests: Quest all Beggars Have; The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal

people.name: Faida
people.byDay: Stays behind the inn's counter all day
people.byNight: UESP doesn't say
people.role: Nord food vendor and innkeeper of the Four Shields Tavern
people.sells: Innkeeper (buys Food, Raw Food; 100 gold); food and drink, rents a room for 10 septims (Four Shields Tavern page)
people.quests: A False Front (Stormcloaks) (directs you to the Imperial Courier); Breaching Security
people.changes: At the start of Breaching Security she is outside the Penitus Oculatus Outpost with Gaius Maro, then heads back to work at the inn.

people.name: Thonnir
people.where: Morthal, Thonnir's House (near the Thaumaturgist's Hut)
people.byDay: From 8am working at Jorgen's mill
people.byNight: From 11pm sleeping in his house
people.role: Nord lumberjack; essential
people.sells: Sells lumber if Hearthfire is installed
people.follows: Only during Laid to Rest: you can take him into Movarth's Lair; he fights alongside you until Movarth is dead
people.changes: Initially outside Highmoon Hall arguing; during Laid to Rest looks for his wife and leads the posse; afterwards returns to his simple life in Morthal (may get stuck in the lair, bug).

people.name: Silda the Unseen
people.byDay: 8am in front of the Palace of the Kings; 4pm between the main gate and Candlehearth Hall; midnight at the Market forge
people.byNight: No sleep package in vanilla (never sleeps); with USLEEP 3.0.5 sleeps 3am-8am on a bedroll in the Temple of Talos
people.role: Nord thief living as a beggar; Pickpocket trainer
people.sells: doesn't sell (UESP shows no merchant role)
people.quests: Blood on the Ice (witness at the graveyard); Quest all Beggars Have
people.changes: Essential until stage 40 of Blood on the Ice; once that quest triggers she is in the graveyard with the other witnesses.

people.name: Dagur
people.byDay: Tends the counter at The Frozen Hearth (inn page)
people.byNight: UESP doesn't say
people.role: Nord innkeeper of The Frozen Hearth (class Food Vendor)
people.sells: Innkeeper (buys Food, Raw Food; 100 gold, +1000 Master Trader); sells food and drinks and rents rooms for 10 gold (Frozen Hearth page)
people.changes: Gets new greetings if the Imperials take Winterhold.

people.name: Assur
people.where: Winterhold, Jarl's Longhouse (Brunwulf Free-Winter's House if exiled)
people.byDay: Wakes 9am, breakfast, wanders the longhouse; 12pm outside playing with Eirid; 6pm two-hour dinner at the Frozen Hearth; home for an hour
people.byNight: Goes to bed at 9pm in the longhouse
people.role: Nord child; son and heir of Jarl Korir
people.sells: doesn't sell (UESP shows no merchant role)
people.changes: If the Imperial Legion takes Winterhold, he and his parents are exiled to Brunwulf Free-Winter's House and stay there all day.

people.name: Vittoria Vici
people.where: Solitude, Vittoria Vici's House (next to Proudspire Manor); works at the docks
people.byDay: After 8am at her stall near the East Empire Company Warehouse entrance for twelve hours; from 8pm wanders her house until midnight
people.byNight: Sleeps in her house between midnight and 8am
people.role: Imperial citizen; oversees the East Empire Company's holdings in Solitude; Emperor's cousin; bride in Bound Until Death
people.sells: Doesn't sell: she was supposed to offer services as a general merchant at the docks but can't be traded with (bug, fixed by USKP 1.2.4)
people.quests: Bound Until Death (the target); Diplomatic Immunity (can cause the distraction); The Spiced Wine
people.changes: Essential until Bound Until Death; during it she is in the courtyard of the Temple of the Divines at her wedding and is killed by the Dark Brotherhood. Killing her before The Spiced Wine starts makes it impossible to complete.

people.name: Torsten Cruel-Sea
people.where: Windhelm, House of Clan Cruel-Sea; owns Hollyfrost Farm
people.byDay: 7am two-hour breakfast; farm for five hours; 2pm market for five hours; Candlehearth Hall dinner for three hours; 10pm Palace of the Kings for two hours (lounges in the main hall on Morndas, Middas, Fredas)
people.byNight: Heads home to bed at midnight
people.role: Nord farmer; patriarch of Clan Cruel-Sea
people.sells: doesn't sell (UESP shows no merchant role)
people.changes: Essential until Summerset Shadows is completed.

people.name: Bothela
people.byDay: 8am-8pm inside her shop handling customers
people.byNight: Locks up and goes to bed after twelve hours of work, wakes at 8am
people.role: Breton apothecary merchant; owns The Hag's Cure
people.sells: Apothecary (buys animal parts, food, ingredients, poisons, potions, raw food, recipes; 500 gold, +500 Investor, +1000 Master Trader); see The Hag's Cure
people.quests: Bothela's Discreet Delivery; Further Study; radiant quests
people.changes: If Bothela dies, Muiri takes over running the store.

people.name: Captain Aldis
people.byDay: 8am-8pm supervising Imperial soldiers' training in the Castle Dour courtyard
people.byNight: Sleeps in the castle 8pm-8am
people.role: Nord captain in the Imperial Legion in charge of the Solitude guards; oversees Roggvir's execution
people.sells: doesn't sell (UESP shows no merchant role)
people.quests: For the Good of Morthal; No News is Good News; Rare Gifts
people.changes: If you side with the Stormcloaks he disappears from the game at the beginning of the Battle for Solitude; finish his quests before then.

people.name: Odvan
people.where: Markarth, Cidhna Mine, then Druadach Redoubt
people.byDay: UESP doesn't say
people.byNight: UESP doesn't say
people.role: Breton witchblade, prisoner in Cidhna Mine
people.sells: doesn't sell (UESP shows no merchant role)
people.changes: Summary location: Cidhna Mine, then Druadach Redoubt.

people.name: Ungrien
people.where: Riften, Black-Briar Meadery; lives in Haelga's Bunkhouse
people.byDay: After a one-hour breakfast, works the meadery tasting counter; noon one-hour meal; work ends 10pm, then leisure at the Bunkhouse
people.byNight: Sleeps at Haelga's Bunkhouse 1am-6am
people.role: Wood Elf food vendor, employee of the Black-Briar Meadery
people.sells: Buys all (100 gold); see Black-Briar Meadery
people.changes: After the Thieves Guild questline he may disappear and be replaced by Romlyn Dreth (not apparently scripted).

people.name: Aicantar
people.byDay: Normally remains in Understone Keep with his uncle Calcelmo
people.byNight: Never sleeps (has a bedroom in Calcelmo's Laboratory but never uses it)
people.role: High Elf conjurer, Calcelmo's nephew; backup Court Wizard
people.sells: Doesn't sell in normal play: only would if Calcelmo died, and Calcelmo is essential
people.changes: During Hard Answers he is in Calcelmo's Laboratory and arrives hostile at the Wizard's Tower; stays there until The Pursuit begins, then returns to Calcelmo (may sometimes stay in the tower for good).

people.name: Mjoll the Lioness
people.byDay: 8am breakfast at Aerin's house; 9am-noon browses the market stalls; noon-6pm at The Bee and Barb; evening patrols the streets for eight hours
people.byNight: Heads home to Aerin's house to sleep for six hours
people.role: Nord warrior and ex-adventurer; essential
people.sells: Doesn't sell (UESP shows no merchant role); after marriage you can buy her extra rings
people.follows: Yes, after Grimsever's Return (recover her sword Grimsever)
people.quests: Grimsever's Return; The Bonds of Matrimony; Rebuilding the Blades; Spread the Love; radiant quests
people.changes: Can be married or recruited to the Blades; if she moves out of Riften Aerin may keep following her (bug).

people.name: Fanari Strong-Voice
people.byDay: Spends all her time in the Greathall except quest events (Wind Stone, speaking with Deor)
people.byNight: Greathall
people.role: Nord chief of Skaal Village
people.sells: doesn't sell (UESP shows no merchant role)
people.quests: A New Source of Stalhrim; Kill the Bandit Leader; witnesses Storn's death in The Gardener of Men

people.name: Asbjorn Fire-Tamer
people.byDay: Two-hour breakfast; 8am-8pm inside the shop (basement tools, upstairs); 8pm two-hour dinner, then strolls
people.byNight: Sleeps in the southwestern room of the shop midnight-6am
people.role: Nord blacksmith, Balimund's apprentice
people.sells: Blacksmith (buys hides, armor, arrows, ore/ingots, tools, weapons; 1000 gold, +500 Investor, +1000 Master Trader); see The Scorched Hammer
people.changes: If Balimund dies, Asbjorn takes over the shop and works the outside forge 8am-8pm.

people.name: Narri
people.byDay: Wakes 8am and relaxes just outside the inn; from 4pm works inside the inn
people.byNight: Works until 1am, then sleeps
people.role: Nord citizen, server at the Dead Man's Drink, works for Valga Vinicia
people.sells: Meant to serve food as a Server, but the option isn't available (bug, fixed by USKP 1.2.1)
people.changes: Meant to take over the inn if something happened to Valga Vinicia but can't (no backup alias; fixed by USKP 1.2.2).

people.name: Leonara Arius
people.byDay: After a two-hour breakfast tends the crops outside; 7pm one-hour dinner in the house
people.byNight: Sleeps in the farmhouse midnight-6am
people.role: Imperial farmer, wife of Addvild
people.sells: doesn't sell (UESP shows no merchant role)

people.name: Morven Stroud
people.where: Soul Cairn, east of the gap in the central wall, in front of a building with his wrecked cart
people.byDay: Stands there (no schedule given)
people.byNight: UESP doesn't say
people.role: Breton trader's trapped soul
people.sells: Trades one leveled item (sword, battleaxe, light armor, heavy armor or spell tome) for 25 soul husks

people.name: Bujold the Intrepid
people.where: Solstheim, Bujold's Retreat, later Thirsk Mead Hall
people.byDay: Wanders the camp (eating, relaxing, tanning rack), three-hour brunch at 10:15am; as Bujold the Intrepid, same routine in Thirsk Mead Hall
people.byNight: Until the Beast Stone is cleansed she leaves at 11:05pm to work at the stone until 6am; after, sleeps 11:05pm-6am (tent, or the hall)
people.role: Nord leader of the Thirsk warriors (Bujold the Unworthy; 'the Intrepid' if she leads the hall)
people.sells: doesn't sell (UESP shows no merchant role)
people.follows: Only during Retaking Thirsk: goes to Hrothmund's Barrow and follows you inside
people.quests: Retaking Thirsk; Her Word Against Theirs
people.changes: If you accept her leading the hall without Hrothmund's blessing she becomes Bujold the Intrepid in Thirsk Mead Hall; if you tell Kuvar the truth she leaves the hall and disappears from the game. Essential during Retaking Thirsk.
